## Nikkei 225: percentage change from the 2026-08-21 close to the 2026-09-12 close

Most article pages refused to load through the proxy, so several facts below come from search-result snippets and could not be checked against the full article. I ignored any information dated after 2026-08-22.

### 1. Resolution source
- 2026-08-21: The ^N225 close on Yahoo Finance was **66,016.36**, according to the code-collected data. Business Standard reports the same: down 0.3% on the day and down 3.93% for the week, ending a two-week winning streak. [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/japan-s-nikkei-falls-as-rising-bond-yields-and-rate-hike-fears-weigh-on-sentiment-126082100689_1.html), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5EN225/)

### 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. The whole 15-session window is still ahead.
- 2026-08-20: The close was 66,216.79, up 1.36%. [note.com market report](https://note.com/hirokimiyano/n/n6b0ba82f04f8?hl=en)
- The index is about 7% below its record. It closed at a record for the fifth day in a row on 2026-06-19, with intraday trade reaching 71,250.06. [nippon.com](https://www.nippon.com/en/news/yjj2026061900882/)

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-22: Bloomberg reports that Fed Chair Kevin Warsh will give his first Jackson Hole speech as chair. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-22/kevin-warsh-to-make-first-jackson-hole-speech-as-fed-chair)
- 2026-08-22: A market commentary frames the last week of August as "the battle for 160 yen" per dollar, driven by Jackson Hole and a speech by a BOJ deputy governor. It also notes that the week's high was 68,713.80 and that rising interest rates hit stocks mid-week. [note.com](https://note.com/hirokimiyano/n/ncf26c2817dcd?hl=en)
- 2026-08-21: Japan's inflation sped up for a second month in a row, which raised expectations of a near-term BOJ rate hike. Rising bond yields weighed on stocks. [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/japan-s-nikkei-falls-as-rising-bond-yields-and-rate-hike-fears-weigh-on-sentiment-126082100689_1.html)
- 2026-08-19: Japan's bad week deepened as the yen, government bonds (JGBs) and stocks all fell. The causes cited were worries about government spending under PM Takaichi and a global tech selloff. [Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/08/19/markets/yen-bonds-nikkei/)
- Around 2026-08-17 to 19: The 10-year JGB yield hit a 30-year high and approached 3%, on bets the BOJ will tighten faster and on fiscal worries. [Nikkei Asia](https://asia.nikkei.com/business/markets/bonds/japan-bond-yields-spike-on-takaichi-budget-fears-worries-over-us-view)
- Background: The BOJ raised its policy rate to 1.0% in June and held it in July. July was the index's first down month in four, falling 8.13% to 64,362.02. [Nikkei Indexes newsletter](https://indexes.nikkei.co.jp/nkave/archives/file/nikkei_indexes_newsletter_vol80.pdf)

### 4. Base rates
I converted the code's price percentiles for the target date into percentage changes from 66,016.36:

| Percentile | Price | Change |
|---|---|---|
| p5 | 61,463 | -6.9% |
| p10 | 62,914 | -4.7% |
| p25 | 65,301 | -1.1% |
| p50 | 67,488 | +2.2% |
| p75 | 70,168 | +6.3% |
| p90 | 71,584 | +8.4% |
| p95 | 72,439 | +9.7% |

- The middle 50% of outcomes spans about 7.4 points, and the middle 90% about 16.6 points.
- The positive median reflects the strong 2023-2026 bull market. The current backdrop is weaker: a -3.9% week, record JGB yields, and a downtrend since the June highs.
- Recent swings are large: -8.1% in July and -3.9% in the week to Aug 21.

### 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-08-11: An aggregator page for Kalshi's "Nikkei at least ¥70,000 in 2026" market showed a leading bracket around 48-51%. Liquidity was thin and the page's figures contradict each other, so it is unreliable. [SimpleFunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/answer/nikkei)
- Polymarket runs daily Nikkei "up or down" markets, but I found none covering this window. [lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/finance/nik-up-or-down-on-june-24-2026)
- I found no analyst target for the Nikkei in early or mid-September.

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Late August (exact dates not confirmed as of Aug 22): Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote and a speech by a BOJ deputy governor. Both could move the yen and yields. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-22/kevin-warsh-to-make-first-jackson-hole-speech-as-fed-chair), [note.com](https://note.com/hirokimiyano/n/ncf26c2817dcd?hl=en)
- 2026-08-26, after the US close: Nvidia earnings. These matter for Japan's AI and chip-heavy stocks such as Advantest and Tokyo Electron. [Wall Street Horizon](https://www.wallstreethorizon.com/nvidia-earnings-calendar)
- About 2026-09-04: US payrolls report.
- About 2026-09-08: Japan's revised Q2 GDP, previewed as a test of bets on a September BOJ hike. [investinglive](https://investinglive.com/stocks/preview-japan-revised-q2-gdp-set-to-test-boj-september-rate-hike-bets/)
- About 2026-09-10 to 11: US CPI and the SQ settlement on Sep 11.
- The BOJ meeting on Sep 17-18 and the FOMC fall after resolution, but positioning ahead of them should affect the window.
- Ongoing risks: the 3% level on the 10-year JGB, the yen near 160 per dollar (where Japan could intervene to support the yen), and Takaichi's fiscal plans.
